Name: WEAPON_NAME_WOODEN_DAGGER
Story_en: A crudely crafted punch dagger. Despite its poor performance, it’s clearly made with care.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_NOVICE_DAGGER
Story_en: A practical dagger made of solid steel. It looks ordinary, but its sharp blade is perfect for striking weak points.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_AWL
Story_en: A massive nail used in construction. In the hands of a weapon master, anything becomes a weapon.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_SPINNER
Story_en: A weapon from another world. Its high-speed rotating blades slice through everything they touch.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_BLOODY_DAGGER
Story_en: A weapon forged from the blood of a great demon. The demon’s blood hardens in air, stronger than steel.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_DRAGON_CLAW
Story_en: A weapon shaped from a dragon’s claw. A warrior from another world defeated the ancient dragon of the west and forged its claw into this weapon.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_LEVIATHANS_FANG
Story_en: The fang of a beast from the abyss. A fisherman crashed his ship into the monster in the deep sea and brought it back.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_ABSOLUTE_RADIANCE
Story_en: The weapon of Archangel Michael. He only bestows it upon those who are truly righteous.

Desc_en: <color=#fffb6e><size=26>Weapon Type : Dagger</size></color>\nRecommended for focused burst damage against bosses.
Name: WEAPON_NAME_S1_DAGGER
Story_en: A legendary dagger said to have always appeared in battles that changed the course of history. As it grows, its dance becomes even more spectacular.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_NOVICE_SWORD
Story_en: An old sword found on the beach. Looks like it might break at any moment.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_WARRIOR_SWORD
Story_en: A longsword for warriors who have shed their novice titles and stepped into the real battlefield. Forged sturdily with the sole purpose of surviving and striking down enemies in actual combat.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_TENTACLE
Story_en: A weapon containing the hand of a monster from the abyss. The seemingly blunt tentacles slice cleaner than steel.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_CORN_SWORD
Story_en: A greatsword from another world. Swinging it somehow makes you crave corn.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_FROZEN_SAVER
Story_en: An ice sword. It brings a chill to the surroundings.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_SUN_SWORD
Story_en: A ceremonial blade once used to worship an ancient ocean god. A fine weapon forged from rare minerals.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_DEPTHBINDER
Story_en: A sword that sealed the king of the abyss. More than being sealed, it seems the sword simply liked sticking around.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_DIVINE_AXIOM
Story_en: A greatsword of judgment said to be forged by the gods themselves. Radiating blinding light, it punishes all evil without mercy.

Desc_en: <color=#fffb6e><size=26>Weapon Type : Longsword</size></color>\nRecommended for countering enemy buffs and cleansing your debuffs in PvP.
Name: WEAPON_NAME_S1_SWORD
Story_en: A greatsword said to have sealed the moon demon. As it grows, its power to purify souls is unleashed.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_MORNINGSTAR
Story_en: Getting hit by this will make stars spin before your eyes.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_HUNTER_HAMMER
Story_en: A massive hammer used for smashing solid walls or rocks. Its sheer weight crushes anything standing in its way.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_THE_LOG
Story_en: A giant log. With enough strength, anything can become a weapon.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_CACTUS
Story_en: Be careful not to get pricked by the cactus thorns.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_IRONBRUTE
Story_en: A mace that strikes down those who have sinned. Its durability allows it to destroy anything in its path.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_DOOMSPIKE
Story_en: A custom weapon used by the Blood Baron. With every swing, it’s said you can hear the screams of its victims.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_NECROCRUSHER
Story_en: A doomsday mace once wielded by the King of the Dead. Those who use it are known as the “Silent Knights” and feared by all.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_SOL_INVICTUS
Story_en: A holy warhammer blessed directly by the Sun God. When it strikes, sanctified light spreads and purifies evil.

Desc_en: <color=#fffb6e><size=26>Weapon Type : Mace</size></color>\nRecommended for increasing stability with shields in field and boss battles.
Name: WEAPON_NAME_S1_MORNINGSTAR
Story_en: The commander of the battlefield that turns the tide of disadvantageous battles. As it grows, its ability to protect allies is unleashed.

Desc_en: <color=#fffb6e><size=26>Weapon Type : Mace</size></color>\nRecommended for increasing stability with shields in field and boss battles.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_WOODEN_CROSSBOW
Story_en: A makeshift wooden crossbow. Easy to craft, but hard to maintain.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_HUNTER_CROSSBOW
Story_en: A weapon built much sturdier than a standard crossbow. The firing power is immensely increased, making every single shot lethal.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_SPIRITBLOOM
Story_en: A mystical crossbow crafted from crystals harvested in the Fairy Forest. It fires petals made of mana rather than arrows.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_NOCTURNE
Story_en: A bizarre crossbow made by alchemists of darkness. The eye ornament pulsates with mana, almost alive.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_HELLPIERCER
Story_en: A blood-red crossbow made from infernal metal. Legend says every fiery bolt releases a demon's scream.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_CRYSTALBOLT
Story_en: A crossbow forged from ice crystals. A battle weapon made by northern snowfield mages, its bolts pierce and freeze targets at once.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_INFERNAL_BOLT
Story_en: A crossbow refined from magma stones mined in volcanic zones. Launches explosive bolts with intense heat.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_ASCENSION
Story_en: A holy crossbow crafted by a celestial blacksmith. Arrows infused with pure light purify evil, and only the chosen can wield it.

Desc_en: <color=#fffb6e><size=26>Weapon Type : Crossbow</size></color>\nRecommended for reaching the highest explosive DPS as you grow.
Name: WEAPON_NAME_S1_CROSSBOW
Story_en: The ultimate crossbow, a product of arcane energy research. As it grows, its energy runs rampant.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_OLD_PISTOL
Story_en: A matchlock pistol from the ancient empire era. Though old, its accuracy is decent and it's a prized collector’s item among treasure hunters.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_HUNTER_BARREL
Story_en: A practical rifle used for hunting beasts in the wild. It can hit distant targets with great accuracy.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_ICE_RAILGUN
Story_en: A magic-powered gun driven by frost mana stones. Developed through northern arcane engineering.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_SUN_PISTOL_EX
Story_en: An enhanced golden pistol excavated from an ancient sun temple. Fires beams blessed by the sun upon use.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_DRAGONY
Story_en: A sentient pistol sealed with a dragon’s soul. It reacts to the wielder’s emotions, spewing fire or lightning accordingly.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_PLASMA_RELIC
Story_en: A relic pistol found in a ruined civilization. Fires powerful plasma shots and defies modern understanding.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_PYRODRAKE
Story_en: A mini dragon-shaped weapon imbued with a fire spirit. Automatically spits flame bullets once held, making it hard to control.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_SERAPHIMS_WRATH
Story_en: A weapon imbued with the wrath of the celestial guardian Seraphim. Only those who represent true justice can wield it.

Desc_en: <color=#fffb6e><size=26>Weapon Type : Gun</size></color>\nRecommended for drastically boosting the entire party's firepower.
Name: WEAPON_NAME_S1_GUN
Story_en: The culmination of future science created to destroy planets. As it grows, bizarre energy is absorbed by allies.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_CUBIC_WAND
Story_en: A basic magic wand. Its cube-shaped magic stone gives it a simple structure, ideal for beginners learning the flow of magic.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_AMBER_WAND
Story_en: A wand focused on increasing the power of pure magic. Unnecessary decorations were removed to make spells cast stronger.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_LUNARIS_STAFF
Story_en: A wand that draws power with the phases of the moon. Forged on a full moon night when lunar energy is at its peak.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_SUN_STAFF
Story_en: A sacred staff forged from shards of frost. Only mages of the 3rd circle or higher can withstand its chill and wield it.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_VISION_STAFF
Story_en: A wand embedded with a crystal sealed with a spirit of foresight. Grants visions of the future, but not without a price.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_ECLIPSE_ROD
Story_en: A magic rod born at the moment of a solar eclipse. It contains both light and darkness, requiring precise control to wield.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_SCARLETHRONE
Story_en: A staff of miracles that exists solely for salvation. The moment it is grasped, an unfathomable power overflows to heal and protect allies.

Name: WEAPON_NAME_ORACLES_RIFT
Story_en: The final legacy left behind by prophets. A powerful wand that attacks by tearing spatial rifts.

Desc_en: <color=#fffb6e><size=26>Weapon Type : Wand</size></color>\nRecommended for sustain through healing when facing multiple enemies.
Name: WEAPON_NAME_S1_WAND
Story_en: A wand that stands as a symbol of human history, marked by repeated peace and war. As it grows, the ability to heal proportional to the destruction caused is unleashed.
